skill.name: create-pr
skill.description: Creates Sentry-style pull requests by checking branch state, reviewing diffs, writing concise descriptions, and using GitHub CLI for publishing and reviewers.
skill.summary: Guides Sentry-style pull request creation with branch checks, PR text, and reviewer setup.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown backticks or fenced examples, not Ruby execution. The confirmed risk is the gh pr create example that uses shell command substitution around generated PR body text. No prompt injection or malicious data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Generated PR body is embedded through shell command substitution.
remediation.suggestion: Use a temporary body file with gh pr create --body-file, or review the final command before execution.

remediation.issue: The skill can create or edit GitHub pull requests through gh commands.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation for the final title, body, base branch, and reviewers before running mutating gh commands.

content.value_statement: This skill helps teams create pull requests that follow Sentry review conventions. It guides branch checks, PR descriptions, titles, issue references, and reviewer selection.
actual_capabilities: Checks current branch status with git status.
Reviews commits with git log against main.
Reviews branch diffs with git diff against main.
Drafts PR descriptions using Sentry what, why, and context guidance.
Creates PRs with GitHub CLI and adds selected reviewers.
limitations: Requires an authenticated GitHub CLI installation.
Assumes the base branch is main.
Does not validate test results or build status.
Uses Sentry conventions, which may not match every repository.

use_cases.title: Prepare a feature PR
use_cases.description: Create a Sentry-style feature pull request with concise context and relevant issue links.

use_cases.title: Open a small fix
use_cases.description: Verify branch state, write a focused bug-fix description, and assign the right reviewers.

use_cases.title: Explain a refactor
use_cases.description: Turn a refactor branch into a clean PR that explains scope, motivation, and review areas.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic PR
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for a ready branch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pull request for my current branch using this skill. Check branch state first, then propose a title and description before creating it.

prompt_templates.title: Draft before publishing
prompt_templates.scenario: Review generated PR text before any GitHub change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the commits and diff against main. Draft a Sentry-style PR title and body, but wait before running gh pr create.

prompt_templates.title: Create and add reviewers
prompt_templates.scenario: Publish a PR and request known reviewers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the PR, then add reviewers I name. Keep the PR body focused on motivation, context, and important review areas.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a complex branch
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for larger or mixed changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my branch against main, identify unrelated changes, propose a split if needed, and create a final PR after my approval.

output_examples.input: User asks to open a feature PR for a Slack notification branch.
output_examples.output: The skill checks branch status, reviews commits and diff, then prepares a concise PR title and body with issue references.

output_examples.input: User asks to add reviewers after a PR is created.
output_examples.output: The skill adds one to three named reviewers or a Sentry team through GitHub CLI.

output_examples.input: User asks for a bug-fix PR description.
output_examples.output: The skill writes a body that explains the null case, the user impact, and the linked issue.

best_practices: Review the proposed PR title and body before publishing.
Keep one feature, bug fix, or refactor per pull request.
Confirm reviewer names and team handles before editing the PR.
anti_patterns: Creating a PR before confirming all changes are committed.
Bundling unrelated changes into one review.
Publishing generated PR text without checking issue links and scope.

faq.question: Does this skill create the pull request automatically?
faq.answer: It can use GitHub CLI to create the PR after the user confirms the title and body.

faq.question: What tools are required?
faq.answer: It requires git and an authenticated gh command in the repository.

faq.question: Does it run tests?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on branch checks, diff review, PR text, and reviewer assignment.

faq.question: Can it use a branch other than main?
faq.answer: The instructions assume main. Ask for a different base branch if your repository uses one.

faq.question: Does it follow Sentry formatting rules?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses Sentry-style title, description, issue reference, and review guidance from the skill.

faq.question: Is it safe for private repositories?
faq.answer: Use it only when the GitHub CLI account has the right repository access. Review all generated PR text before publishing.
